Your Part B premium
is going UP in 2027
In 2027,
the standard Part
B monthly premium
increases by $6.50
from $202.90
up to $209.40
a month.
Over a full
year,
that comes to
$2,512.80
per person,
or $5,025.60
for a married
couple.
Meanwhile,
the annual Part
B deductible
rises by $9,
from $283
to $292.
